# Run ledger (generated by findings/make_ledger.py from transcripts/)

One row per live-model run with our prompts, platform and local. Violations come from the truth-based evaluator, report answers from report_check.py, certainty and requests from instrument_check.py, the codes (proposals, attest, comply) from protocol_screen.py, which reads board, list, tool calls and reports but never private reasoning. Runs cancelled before they started are left out. "-" means the run ended before that point. Set "study" is Kyle's platform run of the 20 frozen panel40 configs (launchKey study-prod-*), which used the original tool wording, not the neutral wording; every other row is a pilot.
